messages:
lucas rao: quick sync: SI asked for a lightweight 'monitoring kiosk' we can drop into partner demos. goal = one-click dashboard + OTLP ingest + alert rules so partners can showcase observability during presales. thoughts? :mag_right:
maria gomez: love it. needs to be tiny and copy-paste friendly. i'm thinking a single manifest + a dashboard json + a small script to generate realistic traces/logs/metrics.
samir patel: agree. scope v1: 1) otel-collector yaml with dd exporter and file exporter (for airgapped), 2) dashboard.json (Datadog) + terraform example, 3) generator script (go or python) with env knobs, 4) alert rule examples (error rate, tail latency). keep everything non-prod and config placeholders only.
lucas rao: must include sampling guidance — customers will worry about volume. add recommended OTLP sampling and a flag to scale event rate. also include hints about batching and max_queue_size.
maria gomez: UX note: partner sales often want a single-file quickstart. we can provide a packaged zip + a demo README and a 2-min screencap. partnerships will maintain the README and example email copy for SIs.
samir patel: i'll own collector.yml and generator. plan to include trace attributes we recommend: service.name, span.kind, model.variant, rw_ms. Also add metric naming: redwood.inference.latency.p50/p95 and redwood.engine.kv_cache.hits.
dd-integ-bot: demo-cluster created: dd-kiosk-1747654321 (k8s: kiosk-ns, otelcol 1/1, demo-app 1/1)
lucas rao: nice. can you add a note to the README about Datadog API key placeholders and using dd-agentless for private setups?
maria gomez: acceptance checklist candidate: 1) OTLP ingestion success shown in Datadog logs, 2) dashboard panels render within 3s, 3) sample traces correlate with metrics, 4) alert fires in test mode when generator toggled to high-error.
samir patel: i'll add a small GH action to run the generator and smoke-test dashboards (curl Datadog API to ensure panels exist). sample curl for locally posting traces:
```\ncurl -X POST \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  http://localhost:4318/v1/traces \\\n  --data @sample-span.json\n```
lucas rao: legal/security: include explicit "no PII" note and a line on replacing keys before sharing with partners. partnerships to own the partner-facing TOU blurb.
maria gomez: timeline: partner workshop is 2026-04-15. dry-run 04/11. can eng have collector + generator ready by 04/05?
samir patel: yes, i'll open repo and push skeleton by EOD tomorrow. will tag @lucas and @maria for content review.
dd-integ-bot: repo scaffolded: github.com/redwood-inference/monitoring-kiosk (private)
lucas rao: awesome. i'll draft the partner-facing one-pager and sample email. maria 1: can you record the 2-min clip by 04/09?
maria gomez: yes, short demo + voiceover. will also add captions.
samir patel: final note: keep dashboard variables minimal (env, service) so SIs can quickly swap. we'll iterate on fancy widgets later.
lucas rao: perfect. thanks team. i'll drop these action items into Notion and set reminders for dry-run date.
